paragraphs: Kings Granite & Quartz LLC is a countertop contractor serving Charlotte, NC, and the name says what we focus on: granite and quartz countertops. If you are replacing tired laminate, updating a kitchen before a sale or finishing a full remodel, the counters are what people touch and see every day, so the material and the fit matter.

Granite is natural stone, so every slab carries its own pattern and color movement. Quartz is engineered, which gives you a more even look from one piece to the next. We are happy to talk through both with you. Call us on a weekday from 7 AM, or on Saturday morning, and tell us about your kitchen.

items.name: Granite countertops
items.blurb: Granite is quarried stone, so no two slabs look quite alike. Some homeowners love the deep speckle of a dark granite on an island, others prefer a lighter stone with soft movement. Tell us the look you are after and we will talk through options.

items.name: Quartz countertops
items.blurb: Quartz gives you a consistent color from end to end, which suits clean, modern kitchens and long runs of counter. Marble-look quartz with gentle gray veining is a popular choice. Ask us how a quartz top would work with your cabinets and backsplash.

items.name: Countertop replacement
items.blurb: Not every kitchen needs new cabinets to feel new. Swapping worn laminate or dated tile counters for granite or quartz can change the whole room. Call us with your cabinet layout and a few photos, and we can talk about what a replacement would involve.

about.text: Kings Granite & Quartz LLC is a countertop contractor working in the Charlotte, NC area. As the name says, our focus is granite and quartz, the two materials most homeowners ask about when they replace kitchen counters. We keep early hours on weekdays, starting at 7 AM, and we are open on Saturday mornings for people who plan their projects on the weekend. If you are weighing stone options or need new counters for a remodel, call us and tell us what you have in mind.

steps.title: Call us
steps.text: Call (980) 239-5929 on a weekday from 7 AM to 5 PM, or Saturday from 9 AM to 1:30 PM.

steps.title: Pick your material
steps.text: We talk through granite and quartz, colors and edges, and how each would look with your cabinets and floors.

steps.title: Measure and plan
steps.text: We go over your layout, sink and cooktop locations and any seams, so you know what to expect before work begins.

steps.title: Installation day
steps.text: Your new countertops go in on the date we agree with you, and we keep you informed if anything changes.

steps.title: Look it over
steps.text: We go over the finished counters with you, including edges, seams and the sink area, before the job is closed out.

service_area.h2: Granite and quartz countertops in Charlotte, NC
service_area.text: Kings Granite & Quartz LLC works in the Charlotte, NC area, including Harrisburg. Our Google profile does not list a street address or a set service area, so the easiest way to find out if we cover your neighborhood is to call (980) 239-5929 on a weekday or Saturday morning and tell us where your kitchen is and what you would like done.

items.q: Should I choose granite or quartz?
items.a: It depends on the look and feel you want. Granite is natural stone, so each slab has its own pattern and color variation. Quartz is engineered, so the color and pattern stay more even across every piece. Many homeowners decide after seeing both. Call us and we will talk through the options for your kitchen.

items.q: What should I have ready when I call?
items.a: A rough sketch or photos of your current counters help a lot, along with the approximate lengths of each run, where the sink and cooktop sit and whether you want a new sink. If you have a color or stone in mind, send a picture of that as well.

We are open Monday through Friday from 7 AM to 5 PM and on Saturday from 9 AM to 1:30 PM. We are closed on Sunday. Call (980) 239-5929 during those hours, or email kings.granite.quartz@gmail.com and include a good time to reach you.

We work in the Charlotte, NC area, including Harrisburg. Google does not show a full service area for us yet, so if you are outside those places, call and tell us your town. We will let you know quickly whether your project is one we can take on.

items.q: How do I get an estimate?
items.a: Call us or send an email with your kitchen layout, approximate measurements and the material you are leaning toward. We will go over what the job involves and the next steps, so you have a clear picture before you make any decisions about your countertops.
